units.source_text: 在弟子村岛五段和日本棋院八幡干事的陪伴下，

en.t: Accompanied by his disciple Murashima 5-dan and Yawata, an officer of the Nihon Ki-in,

units.source_text: 名人夫妇在对局前三天的十一月十五日到达暖香园，

en.t: the Master and his wife arrived at Dankoen on November 15, three days before the match,

units.source_text: 大竹七段于十六日也来了。

en.t: and Otake 7-dan also came on the 16th.
